display_name: 多源信道视图的物理后验残差网络
description: 固定盲信道与条件后验，在三个不同源信道视图上训练物理反投影条件残差网络。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU2, source training only, 2 CPU threads, TF32 disabled; real L_s/U_s full loss gradient smoke

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], fixed blind posterior and action-adjoint residual; source paired ground IQ, legal L_s labels and frozen F soft targets
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: L_s metadata contains 6300 truth labels; only fit-ID L_s truth enters loss; no U_s truth, V or test read
data.validation_ref: 384 RX8 source records, 64 per impaired scene, previously used in pilot; no true labels for evaluation, no checkpoint selection
data.leo_config_ref: Fresh source cache epochs21,22,23 training; original cache epoch19 evaluation; source physical IDs identical

permissions.query_use: source L_s training labels only for optimizer; U_s truth, V and test inaccessible
permissions.claim_scope: Source physical IDs observed in previous channel views, RX8 same prior pilot; no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Random identity-output residual corrector; blind estimator, source Gaussian prior, and F frozen; legal L_s labels enter source training; DURA loaded after training.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Blind action SHA256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338 and source prior SHA256 5e35516d54d3e3d1d1749933861f290c1f87c8ffdb4b863d2f9819914135ceb9
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch3, no source holdout selection; evaluate identical 384 RX8 source records after training; no target IQ.

execution.launch_owner: Codex multi-view posterior residual full training GPU2 owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 single source-only owner, TF32 disabled, resource preflight

execution.stop_rule: Stop only for provenance or role violation, output collision, nonfinite values or technical failure; preserve partial output; never stop for low performance

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: L_s labels train only, source F pseudo targets not actual test truth; fixed prior views and RX8 cohort previously observed, no clean-blind claim.

rows.method: identity-initialized dilated residual network conditioned on blind posterior and action-adjoint residual; legal L_s truth and frozen F soft targets
rows.purpose: test if larger multi-view source training learns a more useful correction direction
rows.seed_notes: fixed prior and RX8 cohort; data-order seed 2026120855, fresh source views21–23
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 38951 source train IDs disjoint from 8192 prior IDs, 3 epochs batch16; 384 RX8 source heldout
